verses.wasilatu-l-mujrimin-ila-ghufrani-ribbi-l: subḥāna man laysa yashū lā walam yanami subḥānahu jalla munshī l-khalqi min ʿadami
ẓalamtu nafsī waʾin lam taghfiran zalalī rabbī watarḥamunī fal-khusru multazimī
ʾinnī lal-ʿinu nafsī laʿna muḥtaqidi lahfī wayā ḥasarātī kullamā ʾumami
fārḥam ʿubaydā ʾilahī tilka ḥālatuhu ḥayrāna khābiṭa layli lābisa ẓ-ẓulami
waʾinnanī fī muqīmi muqʿidi faraqā ʾanqidh qaṭāta fakhākhi qabḍaḍa l-ʿarimi
ʾin qultu ʾatruku laʿnī qultu yā ʿajabā "lā taqnaṭū" ḥaththata mthālī ʿalā l-khidami
hadhā maqāmu dhalīli khāʾifi wajili muʿtarifi sāʾili l-ghufrāni dhā l-karami
yā qābila t-tawbi fāqbal tābatī karamā laysa l-manāṣu lighayri l-qāhiri l-ḥakami
ʾin lam takun qābilā zayfī libahrajahi fakayfa ḥālī waghayra dhāka lam ʾasumi
baddilhu lī bikhilāṣi rāqa manẓarata yasurru shārīna fī bayʿi wafī salami
ʾilayka minka bika l-ʾilḥāḥu muddaʿiyā muthawwibā yā larabbī min dhawī l-jurumi
waʾin ʾatā minka yā ghaffāru maghfiratu siyyāni man ʿindahu l-ʾardā wadhū l-qiyami
wakun mughītha gharīqi mā shraʾabba ʾilā mukhalliṣi ghayra rabbi kāshifa l-ghumami
hadhī yudayyatunā muddat ʾilayka fakhudh waʾakhdhu ghayrika lā yujdī siwā n-nadami
wadhū ftiqāri ʾidhā mā rāma muftaqirā faṭālibu l-ʿawni wal-maṭlūbu fī s-sadami
wakhawwafūnī lifaqdi z-zādi qultu lahum hal yuḥmalu z-zādu lil-ʾajwādi yā ʾumamī
ḥamlīhi ʾin rumtu tarḥālā lahum khajalu naʿam naʿam dhāka taʿjīzu lidhī n-naʿami
ʾilayka ʾashkū ʾumūrā ʾanta taʿlamuhā taḥḥaruqī wānshiwāʾa l-qalbi min saqami
hadhā d-duʿāʾu wajuhdī wal-ʾijābatu wat-t tuklānu minka ʾilayka d-dahra dhā l-karami
ṣalli ʿalā raḥmahi nūri hudā qamari khatmi ʾimāmi nabiyyi ṭāhiri ʿalami
waḥāʾizī qaṣbi sabqi rabbi sabqahumu ʾazkā ṣalāti wataslīmi mina l-ḥakami
